hypothesis: Writing same-slot object-local memory deltas directly into the final action hidden-state residual through both a raw-delta multiplicative gate and a learned directional residual will convert R4's identifiable object memory into causal full-policy use.
objective: Complete 500 finite optimizer steps and save the full checkpoint; keep zero intervention object-delta RMS, main gate deviation, and directional residual RMS exactly zero; keep slot mean absolute off-diagonal cosine below 0.95; make positive temporal similarity exceed both cross-object and cross-episode negative similarity by at least 0.05; and make aligned-history held-out main action loss at least 1 percent lower than both zero-history and batch-shuffled-history interventions. Do not launch 20k unless every gate passes.

config.overrides: R4 competitive visual object memory plus same-slot latest-minus-previous object delta; action-to-object-delta cross-attention; fixed raw-delta multiplicative gate scale 0.25; learned directional residual scale 0.25; R4 iter-500 model-only warm start; train complete strong_action_expert; 500 steps; batch 64 per rank; DP8; accumulation 1; maximum 8 validation batches

data.version: RoboCasa365 B4 processed split plus Wan latent cache and visual-history sidecar
data.revision: 1,143,698 fixed records; 280 shards; same-physical-episode t-36/t-24/t-12 visual-history lookup; same data, packing, and held-out stream as R4; no future or cross-episode lookup

command: launch_b5_vom_probe_r5_8gpu.sh followed by launch_b5_vom_matched_val_r5.sh none, zero, and shuffle; formal 20k remains blocked unless every acceptance gate passes.
hardware: pyrogpucompute1; 8 x NVIDIA B200 183359 MiB; batch 64 per rank; global batch 512

preflight.focused_tests: 28 passed in the production container: strong-action-expert, action-config, and launcher tests
preflight.gpu_smoke: Two-rank NCCL B200 BF16 production-dimension forward/backward finite with loss 2.0407572 and peak allocation 979.43 MiB per rank; object-delta RMS 1.2926080; active fraction 1.0; gate mean/deviation 1.2144434/0.2144435; directional residual RMS 0.0692056; zero hard checks passed; all eight required parameter groups received finite nonzero gradients
preflight.checkpoint_scope: Model-only warm start; visual_memory_delta_main was the only skipped new prefix; optimizer, scheduler, and trainer state were not restored; absolute training target was a new 500-step probe

validation.legacy_validator: The bundled validator still requires SHA-256 fields and baseline.run_ids while simultaneously treating the prior baseline object without run_ids as immutable. Those requirements are superseded by the workflow's higher-priority no-hash and immutability policies; all satisfiable non-hash fields were compared with the prior manifest using jq.
validation.checked_fields: Prelaunch immutable fields, exact formal source, model-only R4 load scope, start and completion timestamps, four run IDs and W&B IDs, four terminal Done markers, fixed 2048/2048 held-out samples in every intervention, step-500 gradient evidence, checkpoint components, and GPU monitor summary

conclusion: R5 made the full policy structurally depend on object-local memory deltas: aligned memory now beat both exact-zero and batch-shuffled interventions, whereas R4 did not. The effect on the main ActionDiT loss was only 0.35283 percent versus zero and 0.09025 percent versus shuffle, despite 31.94 percent and 5.66 percent gains in the memory-only decoder. The object representation remained non-collapsed and zero intervention exactly disabled the new path, but the main policy still relied predominantly on its original context. The causal-use gates failed, so the formal 20k run was not launched.
failure_reason: Aligned held-out main action loss improved over zero and shuffle by less than the required 1 percent, and R5 aligned action loss was 0.19041 percent worse than the R4 aligned baseline. This is positive but insufficient evidence for scaling; no closed-loop success-rate evaluation was run.
